accompany.definition: Go somewhere with someone as a companion or escort.

climb.definition: Go or come up a slope or incline.

curious.definition: Eager to know or learn something; strange or unusual.

knife.definition: An instrument for cutting consisting of a blade attached to a handle.

knowledge.definition: Facts, information, and skills acquired through experience or education.

space.definition: A continuous area or expanse which is free, available, or unoccupied.
